proposal: IEC-ALP-PER-003 case book with one stream table per case.
question: The plant HMB must cover all design and guarantee cases, not only SRC. Please provide rated off-design heat balances (fixed HRSG and condenser surfaces, sliding pressure, attemperation) for: SRC-NG-100; SRC-NG-GT80; SRC-NG-060 (60 % plant net load, PG-03); SRC-NG-MEL (minimum emissions-compliant load, PG-11); SRC-LDO-100 (LDO, PG-15/16); WIN-NG-100 (-4.8 degC, 99.6 %); MIN-NG-100 (-8 degC); SUM-NG-100 (32.8 degC, 0.4 %); MAX-NG-100 (40 degC with 27 degC seawater). Stream numbering as PER-001, with added streams for LDO, injection water and attemperation spray.
response: IEC-ALP-PER-003 Rev 0 issued with the nine cases, one stream table each; the rating model reproduces PER-001 Rev B exactly at SRC. Attemperation spray is in service at part load and at high ambient (streams 29/30).
subject: Off-design heat balances for all design and guarantee cases
